svg.text: PostgreSQL / EF Core model · PK and FK columns shown · arrows point from referenced table to referencing table
Solid line: required FK · dashed line: nullable FK · *UserId in InventoryTransactions is a nullable EF shadow FK.
CategoryId and UnitTypeId on Medicines/Cosmetics are application-managed IDs, not database foreign keys. Archive/reference IDs are not enforced FKs.
